definitions.explanation: For something to move from an open to closed position on its own, or to be in a closed state. The intransitive pair of {閉|し}める.

examples.japanese: ドアが{閉|し}まりました。
{店|みせ}は{閉|し}まっています。
{窓|まど}が{閉|し}まっていますか。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pair: {閉|し}める (transitive). Pattern: Xが{閉|し}まる (X closes).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {閉|し}まっている = 'is closed' (state, not process).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・ドアが{閉|し}まる (the door closes)
・{店|みせ}が{閉|し}まっている (the store is closed)
・{窓|まど}が{閉|し}まっている (the window is closed)
・{閉|し}まる{時間|じかん} (closing time)

PAIR: {閉|し}める (transitive) - ドアを{閉|し}めた (closed the door). Opposite: {開|あ}く (to open - intransitive).
